subject: 🎓 Offer of Admission — $program_applied
body:
Dear $applicant_name,

Congratulations! On behalf of the Admissions Committee, I am delighted to offer you a place on the following programme for the $academic_year academic year.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
OFFER DETAILS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Application ID:   $application_id
Programme:        $program_applied
Intake:           $semester $academic_year
Offer Type:       $offer_type
Decision Date:    $decision_date

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

NEXT STEPS

  1. Accept your offer through the applicant portal by $accept_by.
  2. Pay the enrolment deposit of £$deposit_amount by $deposit_due (this secures your place).
  3. Submit any outstanding conditions or supporting documents.
  4. Watch your inbox for enrolment, accommodation, and induction details.

Any conditions attached to this offer:
$offer_conditions

If you have questions, please reply to this email or contact the Admissions Office at admissions@university.edu.

We look forward to welcoming you to the University.

Kind regards,
University Admissions Office
